chapter_title.ar: باب مَوْلِدِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام )
chapter_title.en: Chapter 120 – Arrival of Abu Al Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/68)

translations.bn: সা'দ ইবন আবদুল্লাহ এবং আবদুল্লাহ ইবন জা'ফার, উভয়ে একসাথে, ইব্রাহিম ইবন মাহজিয়ার থেকে, তাঁর ভাই আলি ইবন মাহজিয়ার থেকে, আল-হুসাইন ইবন সাঈদ থেকে, মুহাম্মদ ইবন সিনান থেকে, ইবন মুসকান থেকে, আবু বাসির থেকে, যিনি বলেছেন:
translations.de: Sa'd ibn Abdullah und Abdullah ibn Ja'far, beide zusammen, von Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, von seinem Bruder Ali ibn Mahziyar, von al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, von Muhammad ibn Sinan, von Ibn Muskan, von Abu Basir, der sagte:
translations.en: Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
translations.es: Sa'd ibn Abdullah y Abdullah ibn Ja'far, ambos juntos, de Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, de su hermano Ali ibn Mahziyar, de al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, de Ibn Muskan, de Abu Basir, quien dijo:
translations.fa: سعد بن عبدالله و عبدالله بن جعفر، هر دو با هم، از ابراهیم بن مهزیار، از برادرش علی بن مهزیار، از حسین بن سعید، از محمد بن سنان، از ابن مسکان، از ابو بصیر، که گفت:
translations.fr: Sa'd ibn Abdullah et Abdullah ibn Ja'far, tous deux ensemble, d'Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, de son frère Ali ibn Mahziyar, d'al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, d'Ibn Muskan, d'Abu Basir, qui a dit :
translations.id: Sa'd ibn Abdullah dan Abdullah ibn Ja'far, keduanya bersama-sama, dari Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, dari saudaranya Ali ibn Mahziyar, dari al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, dari Muhammad ibn Sinan, dari Ibn Muskan, dari Abu Basir, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Са'д ибн Абдуллах и Абдуллах ибн Джа'фар, оба вместе, от Ибрахима ибн Махзияра, от его брата Али ибн Махзияра, от аль-Хусайна ибн Са'ида, от Мухаммада ибн Синана, от Ибн Мускана, от Абу Басира, который сказал:
translations.tr: Sa'd ibn Abdullah ve Abdullah ibn Ja'far, birlikte, Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar'dan, onun kardeşi Ali ibn Mahziyar'dan, al-Husayn ibn Sa'id'den, Muhammad ibn Sinan'dan, Ibn Muskan'dan, Abu Basir'den rivayet etti ki şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: سعد بن عبداللہ اور عبداللہ بن جعفر، دونوں مل کر، ابراہیم بن مہزیار سے، ان کے بھائی علی بن مہزیار سے، الحسین بن سعید سے، محمد بن سنان سے، ابن مسکان سے، ابو بصیر سے، جنہوں نے کہا:
translations.zh: Sa'dibnAbdullah和AbdullahibnJa'far二人一起，传自IbrahimibnMahziyar，传自其兄AliibnMahziyar，传自al-HusaynibnSa'id，传自MuhammadibnSinan，传自IbnMuskan，传自AbuBasir，他说：

translations.bn: মূসা ইবন জা'ফার (عليه السلام) চুয়ান্ন বছর বয়সে, একশ তিরাশি সালে ইন্তিকাল করেন, এবং তিনি জা'ফার (عليه السلام)-এর পর পঁয়ত্রিশ বছর জীবিত ছিলেন।
translations.de: Musa ibn Ja'far (Friede sei mit ihm) verstarb im Alter von vierundfünfzig Jahren im Jahr einhundertdreiundachtzig, und er lebte fünfunddreißig Jahre nach Ja'far (Friede sei mit ihm).
translations.en: Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) passed away when he was fifty-four years old, in the year one hundred and eighty-three, and he lived for thirty-five years after Ja'far (عليه السلام).
translations.es: Musa ibn Ja'far (la paz sea con él) falleció cuando tenía cincuenta y cuatro años, en el año ciento ochenta y tres, y vivió treinta y cinco años después de Ja'far (la paz sea con él).
translations.fa: موسی بن جعفر (علیه السلام) در سن پنجاه و چهار سالگی، در سال صد و هشتاد و سه، از دنیا رفت و پس از جعفر (علیه السلام) سی و پنج سال زندگی کرد.
translations.fr: Musa ibn Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui) est décédé à l'âge de cinquante-quatre ans, en l'an cent quatre-vingt-trois, et il a vécu trente-cinq ans après Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui).
translations.id: Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) wafat ketika berusia lima puluh empat tahun, pada tahun seratus delapan puluh tiga, dan beliau hidup selama tiga puluh lima tahun setelah Ja'far (عليه السلام).
translations.ru: Муса ибн Джа'фар (мир ему) скончался в возрасте пятидесяти четырёх лет, в году сто восемьдесят третьем, и он прожил после Джа'фара (мир ему) тридцать пять лет.
translations.tr: Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s.) elli dört yaşındayken, yüz seksen üç yılında vefat etti ve Ja'far'dan (a.s.) sonra otuz beş yıl yaşadı.
translations.ur: موسیٰ بن جعفر (عليه السلام) پچپن سال کی عمر میں سن ایک سو تراسی میں وفات پا گئے، اور انہوں نے جعفر (عليه السلام) کے بعد پینتیس سال زندگی گزاری۔
translations.zh: 穆萨·伊本·贾法尔（愿主赐他平安）在五十四岁时去世，卒于一百八十三年，并且在贾法尔（愿主赐他平安）之后又活了三十五年。

en.بَعْدَ جَعْفَرٍ: after Ja'far (عليه السلام), indicating the period following his father
en.عَامِ ثَلَاثٍ وَثَمَانِينَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and eighty-three
en.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death
en.مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), the subject of the report

seo_questions.bn: ইমাম মূসা ইবন জা'ফার (عليه السلام) কবে ইন্তিকাল করেন, এবং তাঁর বয়স কত ছিল?
seo_questions.de: Wann verstarb Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (Friede sei mit ihm), und wie alt war er?
seo_questions.en: When did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) pass away, and how old was he?
seo_questions.es: ¿Cuándo falleció el Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (la paz sea con él) y cuántos años tenía?
seo_questions.fa: امام موسی بن جعفر (علیه السلام) چه زمانی از دنیا رفت و چند ساله بود؟
seo_questions.fr: Quand l'imam Musa ibn Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui) est-il décédé, et quel âge avait-il ?
seo_questions.id: Kapan Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) wafat, dan berapa usianya?
seo_questions.ru: Когда скончался имам Муса ибн Джа'фар (мир ему), и сколько ему было лет?
seo_questions.tr: İmam Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s.) ne zaman vefat etti ve kaç yaşındaydı?
seo_questions.ur: امام موسیٰ بن جعفر (عليه السلام) کی وفات کب ہوئی، اور ان کی عمر کتنی تھی؟
seo_questions.zh: 伊玛目穆萨·伊本·贾法尔（愿主赐他平安）何时去世，他当时多大年纪？

summaries.bn: এই বর্ণনাটি ইমাম মূসা ইবন জা'ফার (عليه السلام)-এর ইন্তিকাল নথিভুক্ত করে, তাঁর মৃত্যুকালে বয়স এবং যে বছরে তিনি ইন্তিকাল করেন তা উল্লেখ করে। এতে আরও বলা হয়েছে যে তিনি ইমাম জা'ফার (عليه السلام)-এর পর কত বছর জীবিত ছিলেন, ফলে এটি ইমামের জীবনের কালক্রম সম্পর্কে একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত জীবনীমূলক প্রতিবেদন।
summaries.de: Diese Überlieferung hält den Tod von Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (Friede sei mit ihm) fest, nennt sein Alter beim Tod und das Jahr seines Ablebens. Sie vermerkt auch, wie lange er nach Imam Ja'far (Friede sei mit ihm) lebte, und ist damit ein knapper biografischer Bericht über die Chronologie des Lebens des Imams.
summaries.en: This narration records the passing of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), stating his age at death and the year in which he passed away. It also notes the length of time he lived after Imam Ja'far (عليه السلام), making it a concise biographical report about the Imam's life chronology.
summaries.es: Esta narración registra el fallecimiento del Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (la paz sea con él), indicando su edad al morir y el año en que falleció. También señala cuánto tiempo vivió después del Imam Ja'far (la paz sea con él), por lo que es un breve informe biográfico sobre la cronología de la vida del Imam.
summaries.fa: این روایت، وفات امام موسی بن جعفر (علیه السلام) را ثبت می‌کند و سن ایشان در هنگام وفات و سال وفاتشان را بیان می‌دارد. همچنین مدت زمانی را که پس از امام جعفر (علیه السلام) زندگی کردند ذکر می‌کند و بدین‌سان گزارشی کوتاه و زندگینامه‌ای از ترتیب زمانی زندگی امام است.
summaries.fr: Ce récit consigne le décès de l'imam Musa ibn Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui), en indiquant son âge au moment de sa mort et l'année de son décès. Il précise aussi combien de temps il a vécu après l'imam Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui), ce qui en fait un bref rapport biographique sur la chronologie de la vie de l'imam.
summaries.id: Riwayat ini mencatat wafatnya Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), menyebutkan usia beliau saat wafat dan tahun wafatnya. Riwayat ini juga mencatat berapa lama beliau hidup setelah Imam Ja'far (عليه السلام), sehingga menjadi laporan biografis singkat tentang kronologi حياة Imam.
summaries.ru: Этот рассказ фиксирует кончину имама Мусы ибн Джа'фара (мир ему), указывая его возраст на момент смерти и год его ухода из жизни. Также отмечается, сколько лет он прожил после имама Джа'фара (мир ему), что делает этот текст кратким биографическим сообщением о хронологии жизни имама.
summaries.tr: Bu rivayet, İmam Musa ibn Ja'far'ın (a.s.) vefatını kaydeder; vefatındaki yaşını ve vefat ettiği yılı belirtir. Ayrıca İmam Ja'far'dan (a.s.) sonra ne kadar süre yaşadığını da not ederek, İmam'ın hayat kronolojisine dair kısa bir biyografik kayıt sunar.
summaries.ur: یہ روایت امام موسیٰ بن جعفر (عليه السلام) کے وصال کو بیان کرتی ہے، ان کی وفات کے وقت عمر اور سنِ وفات ذکر کرتی ہے۔ اس میں یہ بھی بتایا گیا ہے کہ انہوں نے امام جعفر (عليه السلام) کے بعد کتنے سال زندگی گزاری، اور یوں یہ امام کی زندگی کی زمانی ترتیب پر ایک مختصر سوانحی روایت ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段传述记录了伊玛目穆萨·伊本·贾法尔（愿主赐他平安）的去世，说明了他去世时的年龄以及去世的年份。它还提到他在贾法尔（愿主赐他平安）之后又活了多少年，因此这是一则关于伊玛目生平时间顺序的简短传记性记述。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/68)
text: قُبِضَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ ابْنُ أَرْبَعٍ وَ خَمْسِينَ سَنَةً فِي عَامِ ثَلَاثٍ وَ ثَمَانِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ وَ عَاشَ بَعْدَ جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) خَمْساً وَ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً .

en.hubeali: Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty-four years old, in the year one hundred and eighty three (A.H.), and he<sup>asws</sup> lived after (his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>) Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> for thirty five years’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali from Ali ibn Ja‘far who has said the following. “Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il came to me when we were still in Makka after completing our ‘Umra in the month of Rajab. He said, “Uncle, I intend to go to Baghdad but I want to say farewell to my uncle, abu al-Hassan Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.) aand I would like that you also come with me.” I came with him to my brother and he was in his house in al-Hawba It was just after sun set. I knocked the door and my brother answered the door asking, “Who is it?” I replied, “It is Ali.” He said, “I am just coming.” He would do his Wudu very slowly. I said, “Be quick please.” He said, “I will be quick.” He came out wearing dyed clothe that he secured around his neck and sat down just below the door steps. I, Ali ibn Ja‘far leaned over him and kissed his head and said, “I have come for a matter to find out if you would agree then Allah may grant him success, if you would not agree then it is one of those mistake that we make.” He asked, “what is it?” I said, “This is the son of your brother. He wants to say farewell to you because he wants to go to Baghdad.” He said to me, “Call him.” I called him and he had kept some distance. He came close to him and kissed his head and said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, please advise me.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “I advise you to be pious before Allah and spare my life.” He in answer said, “Whoever would have bad intentions towards you, may Allah have the same for him.” He continued to pray against those who would have bad intentions towards the Imam (a.s.). He them kiss the head of the Imam (a.s.) again and said, “Please advise me.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “I advise you to be pious before Allah and spare my life.” may or not.” He in answer said, “Whoever would have bad intentions towards you, may Allah have the same for him.” He kissed the head of the Imam (a.s.) and said, “Please advise me.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “I advise you to be pious before Allah and spare my life.” He prayed against those who would have bad intentions towards the Imam (a.s.) and moved away and I left along with him. My brother called me and said, “O Ali, wait where you are.” I waited and he went inside and then called me inside. I went inside and he gave me a bag with a hundred Dinars in it and said, “Tell your cousin to use it during his journey.” The narrator has said, “I secured the money in my dress and he gave me another hundred Dinar to give to him also and then he give me one more bag to give to him. I said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, “When you are afraid of him so much then why do you give him all this money and why do you support him to against your own self?.” He said, “When I would maintain good relations with him and would cut off such relationships Allah will cut his life short.” Then he gave to me a pillow with three hundred pure Dirhams (units of money) in it and asked to give him also.” The narrator has said, “I then left and gave him the first one hundred and he became extremely happy and prayed for his uncle. I then gave him the other money and he became so happy that I thought he might not go to Baghdad any more. I then gave him all the Dirhams and he left for Baghdad. He greeted Harun as the Caliph and said, “I did not think that there can be two caliphs on earth at the same time. I also saw my uncle Musa ibn Ja‘far being greeted as the Caliph.” Harun sent him one hundred thousand Dirhams. He fell sich with Diphtheria or scrofulous and died before seeing or touching any of those money.”
